definition: the safe place you do not want to leave
description: An outdoor swimming pool on a hot day. In front, a young woman in sunglasses and a coral bikini lies relaxed on a big pink doughnut-shaped float with a drink in her hand, waves and then settles back without moving from her spot. Behind her, a young man jumps from the top of a tall white diving tower with his arms and legs spread, another person dives head first and splashes into the water, and a man climbs the ladder. Striped beach huts and people sunbathing line the pool.
